source_policy.identity: exact CURRENT graph row XML/BI4/GenCase receipt/completed solver receipt
source_policy.same_cfl: new SaveDt XML overlay with CURRENT CFL values and original particle BI4
source_policy.half_cfl: same overlay plus exactly two generated cflnumber value changes to half
source_policy.dependencies: all relative motion/auxiliary input files materialized beside overlay; F3 acctimes CSV included
source_policy.old_preflight: reported as source control/window evidence only; it does not grant SaveDt or dense-pair dt credit

cost_policy.native: full graph window and every planned dense frame retained
cost_policy.storage: graph raw_native_reserved_bytes plus 256MiB SaveDt/log margin per request
cost_policy.two_frame_ratio: diagnostic only, never used as full-window upper bound
cost_policy.actual_guard: parent v4 UUID/lease/terminal storage guard remains authoritative

unknowns: actual solver wall time and terminal bytes
DtAllInfo row count/final time until a guarded run
per-step clamp locations; Run.out provides aggregate only
